title: The False Prophet
text: A prophet stands on a milestone on the pilgrim road, ragged and burning-eyed, preaching that the Six are dead and the shrines are tombs. The pilgrims around him are listening. Some are weeping. Some have already thrown away their prayer beads.

options.label: The wisest debates him before the pilgrims, and fights for their faith.

outcomes.text: The pilgrims pick up their beads and turn back to the road.
He wins. The pilgrims look at you with pity, and some of you begin to wonder.

options.label: Listen to his sermon, and judge for yourselves whether the Six are dead.

outcomes.text: He makes a terrible kind of sense. It stays with you like a stone in the shoe.

options.label: Silence him, before his words spread any further.

outcomes.text: The pilgrims scatter. Some of them run toward the Gate to see for themselves.
